subject: Reserved pool throughput assurance annex — renewal + expansion
messages:
From: Alicia Park <procurement@hightower.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@hightower.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: request to expand reserved pool + throughput guarantee annex

Diego,

Thanks again for the renewal summary — Hightower is ready to move forward on the 24‑month renewal, but we need to fold in an expansion and a clearer throughput guarantee before finance signs. Scope below:

- Add 8x A100-equivalent GPUs to our existing reserved pool (baseline + 2x burst nodes).
- Contractual tokens/sec guarantee for the combined pool: 120,000 tokens/sec steady-state with a 240,000 tokens/sec burst allowance for 60s, subject to reasonable warmup.
- We need SLO language, monitoring/alerting, and a credit schedule if the tokens/sec guarantee is missed for X minutes in a month.

Can you share an addendum with draft SLOs and the operational runbook that will live in the contract? Procurement and engineering (Ethan) will review.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Park
Head of Procurement, Hightower AI
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <procurement@hightower.ai>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@hightower.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: request to expand reserved pool + throughput guarantee annex

Alicia — appreciate the clarity. We can absolutely capture this in an annex; attaching a first pass ("annex_draft_tokensps.docx"). High-level notes up front:

- Baseline: we’ll reserve the additional 8 GPUs into a dedicated pool for Hightower for the term. Tokens/sec commitment will be for the provisioned pool as measured at the ingress rate to the pool (aggregated across all nodes).
- Guarantee: steady-state 120k tokens/sec with a 2x burst for 60s windows. We propose a 10-minute warmup window post‑incident or pool start before full burst capability is considered available.
- SLOs / penalties: we suggest a credit ladder (first 30 mins/month = 10% monthly service credit to the platform fee; 30–120 mins = 30% credit; >120 mins = negotiated remediation + escalation). We can pivot numbers with legal, but this is operationally reasonable.
- Fallbacks: automatic routing to a compatible model variant with scaled quantization when the pool drops below 70% capacity to preserve availability. Latency SLO will be attached separately (p95 generation per request <= 1.2s for our standard prompt mix).

Marissa will draft the operational runbook (daily warm-up, cache pre-warm, canary ramp plan, monitoring hooks). Vivek — please confirm if the warmup and burst windows fit current autoscaler behavior and whether we should specify a minimum steady-state request distribution (spikiness assumptions).

Next steps: Marissa to upload runbook + test plan; legal redlines; then DocuSign annex. We can meet tomorrow 9am PT if you want to run the SLA language live.

Best,
Diego
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <procurement@hightower.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2027 15:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: request to expand reserved pool + throughput guarantee annex

Looping in operational details / playbook (summary):

- Performance measurement: tokens/sec is measured at the ingress trampoline before batching, averaged in 1s windows, with a 60s rolling aggregate used for burst enforcement.
- Warmup behavior: cache priming and KV warmups executed on pool start; recommend a 10–15 minute controlled ramp to reach steady-state for new capacity after deployment.
- Canary plan: 10% traffic for 15 minutes -> 50% for 30 minutes -> full cutover. Automated rollback if p95 latency increases by >30% or token acceptance drops >15%.
- Monitoring / alerts: we will provide a per‑pool dashboard (token ingress, token accept rate, batching efficiency, avg kv hit rate) and pager hooks for SREs. Alert thresholds for token shortfall will map to the credit ladder.
- Test validation: before signature, we propose a joint verification day where Redwood runs a 2-hour soak with synthetic load to validate the 120k steady-state and the 240k burst behavior (subject to pattern assumptions).

Attachments: annex_draft_tokensps.docx (initial SLA language).

Marissa
Senior Product Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@hightower.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Park <procurement@hightower.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: request to expand reserved pool + throughput guarantee annex

Diego / Marissa — legal reviewed and sent redlines (attached: redline_throughput_annex.pdf). Two quick asks from our end:

1) Credit calculus: we need clearer SLA measurement windows (30s vs 60s) and that credits are calculated as % of the monthly reserved fee only (not total consumption).
2) Escalation: include a named escalation path (contacts for SRE, account team) and a 24/7 support option for production-impacting throughput shortfalls during business-critical windows.

We like the canary plan; the joint verification day is required before billing for the expansion begins.

— Ethan
Sr. Eng Manager, Reliability — Hightower AI
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <procurement@hightower.ai>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@hightower.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: request to expand reserved pool + throughput guarantee annex

Alicia / Ethan — thanks for the fast turnaround. We reviewed the redlines and made two edits per your asks:

- Measurement window: primary enforcement will use 60s rolling aggregates, with a 30s diagnostic window recorded for dispute resolution. Credits will be computed against the monthly reserved pool fee only and will be applied as pro-rated service credits on the invoice following the month of the incident.
- Escalation path: we added named SRE contacts + 24/7 on-call option during business-critical windows (per the annex); we’ll confirm names & phone numbers in the final DocuSign envelope.

Next actions:
- Marissa: schedule the joint verification day (preferably next Tuesday 9/14) and circulate the runbook + test harness.
- Legal (Redwood): prepare final annex for DocuSign with the agreed credit ladder and measurement language.
- Diego: will send the DocuSign link once legal uploads the final PDF (expect EOD Wed).

Attaching the redline we integrated (redline_throughput_annex.pdf). Please confirm final signatory and whether you want the 24‑month term to start on signature date or the renewal effective date.

Diego
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
